name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg_h9b-h9b-pinflop-ring-COMMIT
purpose: H9b (H-PC Claude 2026-10-16): H9 routed nothing but its CTS native probe failed capture 404.8 ps on 37 inputs (k_addr/k_len legality adder + k_v skid push select + kr_rdy skid pop select straight from pins; results/arch/hbm_pc_cfg_h9/cts_native/native_audit.json). H9b: pure K pin flops, legality from flops, 3-entry K ring (no data moves on pop) with registered k_rdy (+1 K request edge, full rate), kr_rdy pin-registered (ready-latency-1, consumer vmks KRL1 3-entry slot), recipe 4 / hold_budget die (no pin pads). Same 185.76 x 164.16 outline and 1229 pins.
